items.title: Mozilla Firefox gets new anti-fingerprinting defenses
items.description: Mozilla announced a major privacy upgrade in Firefox 145 that reduces even more the number of users vulnerable to digital fingerprinting. [...]

items.title: OWASP Highlights Supply Chain Risks in New Top 10
items.description: Security misconfiguration jumped to second place while injection vulnerabilities dropped, as organizations improve defenses against traditional coding flaws.

items.title: GlassWorm Returns, Slices Back into VS Code Extensions
items.description: GlassWorm, a self-propagating VS Code malware first found in the Open VSX marketplace, continues to infect developer devices around the world.

items.title: Hackers Exploiting Triofox Flaw to Install Remote Access Tools via Antivirus Feature
items.description: Google's Mandiant Threat Defense on Monday said it discovered n-day exploitation of a now-patched security flaw in Gladinet's Triofox file-sharing and remote access platform. The critical vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2025-12480 (CVSS score: 9.1), allows an attacker to bypass authentication and access the configuration pages, resulting in the upload and execution of arbitrary payloads. items.title: CISA orders feds to patch Samsung zero-day used in spyware attacks
